answer: A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The echo multiplier is published, charged in cipher, and forge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 10 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 2310 identities would post 1694 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
